Title: Director Data Analytics
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

# Company Overview
We are the better way to work in finance.
As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE—where sponsors and CFOs meet.
Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value—supporting the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.
If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.
As we build our European footprint, the London office presents a unique entrepreneurial opportunity to shape our presence and accelerate growth across the region—while benefiting from the support and stability of an established, industry-leading firm.
Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great.
Come make your mark.
# Practice Description
Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.
We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.
We deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.
This role is based in London and with the flexibility to work remotely.
Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.
This position is eligible for visa sponsorship.
# What You’ll Do
- Lead across multiple engagements at once with a strategic, light‑touch cadence, ensuring every project tracks to north star outcomes.
- Support go‑to‑market across European PE sponsors and portfolio CFOs, turning relationships into qualified opportunities.
- Shape and quality‑assure proposals and pricing, partnering with MDs and Hyderabad managers.
- Integrate Data & Analytics into FinStrat, CFO Tech, and Transformation, showing how data accelerates FP&A models and CFO change.
- Set delivery standards and ways of working for a one‑team UK–India model, removing blockers and resolving issues quickly.
- Guide SteerCo narrative and escalation, keeping sponsors confident and decisions moving.
- Develop the team, mentoring VPs and managers, and informing the UK hiring plan and Hyderabad squad composition.
- Amplify wins, securing references, case studies, and event exposure with our marketing team.
- Shape proposals and pricing with clear problem statements, scope, commercials, and a pragmatic plan of work.
- Translate strategy into build, turning ambiguous asks into simple, usable solutions and actionable insights.
- Regularly engage in peer level discussions with the C-Suite / C-1 Suite of client organisations, to partner with them as a trusted data management advisor.
- Regularly and extensively travel across Europe to work with clients in the relevant jurisdictions
# What good looks like
- Healthy multi‑engagement portfolio with clear success measures and predictable delivery.
- Growth from European PE houses and from US sponsor relationships extended into Europe.
- Repeatable solution patterns adapted for Europe, reducing cost to serve without lowering quality.
- Strong sentiment from sponsors and CFOs, turning into referrals and pipeline.
- A high‑performing hybrid team, with Directors and VPs operating as consistent quality bar‑
# What you will bring
- Credibility with PE sponsors and portfolio CFOs, plus a record of shaping and selling data‑led work.
- Ability to translate strategy into pragmatic delivery plans that our India hub can execute at pace.
- Strong proposal writing and commercial judgement, including pricing for value.
- Experience leading multi‑project portfolios and cross‑practice collaboration.
- People leadership, mentoring senior ICs, and setting standards across distributed teams.
# You Have
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
- Master’s degree will be an added advantage.
- Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience with 2+ years’ experience in client facing/professional services environment.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Strong leadership & proactive communication to coordinate with the project team and other internal stakeholders.
# You Are
- A self-starter with a strong work ethic.
- A leader of others; you lead by example.
- A strong team player, able to work with team members across all levels.
- Able to effectively communicate complex issues and solutions, and raise issues to senior team members when necessary.
- Comfortable managing projects with multiple complex workstreams while also focused on your single workstream (you are managing and doing).
- Excited to be part of a growing team, with a focus on driving future growth.
- Full of entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable in a fluid, flat organization.
- Knowledgeable about the relationship between Private Equity sponsors and their portfolio companies.
- Passionate about delivering exceptional client service.
- Someone who enjoys mentoring others and doing meaningful work.
- Willing to get your hands dirty in the details of a project while simultaneously seeing the whole picture.
We’re committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
We do not discriminate on the grounds of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, nationality, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other status protected under applicable law.
Please note that, in line with Accordion policy, we do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party recruitment agencies unless such agencies have been formally engaged to provide candidates for a specified vacancy and in alignment with our inclusive diversity values.
Any employment agency, individual, or entity that submits an unsolicited CV does so with the understanding that Accordion reserves the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting agency, individual, or entity.

Title: Salesforce Consultant Core

This position bridges the gap between functional business consulting and technical architecture, serving as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients.
You will lead solution design, advise on technical feasibility, and guide implementation strategies without being responsible for hands-on coding.
This role requires a seasoned expert who can "own the room" with technical stakeholders while translating complex business needs into scalable, high-impact Salesforce solutions.
# Key Responsibilities
- Lead solution design and technical discovery sessions for enterprise-level projects, acting as the primary Architect-leaning lead.
- Act as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding them on what is technically feasible versus what is not recommended based on platform best practices.
- Translate complex business requirements into clear technical blueprints, ensuring solutions are scalable and align with long-term digital transformation goals.
- Lead workshops and provide thought leadership across Sales, Service, and Experience Clouds, ensuring architecture aligns with compliance and security requirements.
- Partner closely with developers and engineering teams to guide integrations and customizations (without performing the coding yourself).
- Support pre-sales efforts by providing strategic input and accurate level-of-effort estimates for complex technical customizations.
- Drive client-facing technical conversations and lead difficult discussions with executive stakeholders to ensure project alignment.
- Coach and mentor team members across functional and technical areas; contribute to internal enablement assets and industry process blueprints.
# Required Expertise
- 10–15 years of Salesforce consulting experience, with a background in Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Technical Lead roles.
- Deep functional and technical knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
- Strong understanding of system architecture, including APIs, data flows, and middleware (iPaaS) platforms.
- Proven experience with Salesforce FSC (Financial Services Cloud), specifically within wealth and asset management.
- Advanced skills in declarative automation, reporting, and complex system configurations.
- Expertise in planning complex data migrations and designing point-to-point integrations.
- While industry-agnostic candidates are welcome, experience in CMT (Communications, Media & Tech) or TMT is a significant plus.
# What We Look For
- The ability to push back on client requests with data-driven reasoning and platform-specific best practices.
- A track record of coaching and developing others with a focus on growing the team’s technical maturity.
- Exceptional facilitation skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between business-centric and developer-centric discussions.
# What This Role is Not
- This is not a developer role. There is no requirement for hands-on coding or custom Apex development.
- This not a purely functional role. You must have the technical depth to lead architecture-level discussions.

> - Put People First: Build trusted relationships with clients and mentor teammates.
> - Grow Together, Win Together: Share knowledge, celebrate wins, and elevate others.

Title: Digital Manufacturing Lead SCADA MES Data
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

Vulcan Elements is manufacturing American rare-earth permanent magnets for a secure, resilient future.
With a focus on national security and economic resiliency, we serve critical industries such as defense, aerospace, and automotive powering a high-technology future.
Vulcan Elements is building a team of ambitious professionals committed to Mission Focus, Technical Excellence, and Integrity.
# The Role
As the Digital Manufacturing Lead you will own the digital manufacturing layer - SCADA, batch execution, historian, MES, and the plant data layer - for a massive 1 million square foot manufacturing facility expansion.
You will lead the SCADA, MES, and data engineers who build the manufacturing stack.
This is a high-impact, high-ownership architecture and leadership role, based in Durham, NC and transitioning to the Benson, NC facility as commissioning begins, with occasional travel to OEM factory acceptance tests and platform vendor engagements.
# Core Expectations & Responsibilities
- Own the cell/area normalization layer that takes non-standard OEM skids and presents one consistent model of the plant to every system above it. Architecture, build sequence, redundancy, and failure behavior.
- Hold the functional allocation between SCADA, batch execution, MES, and the data layer which system owns recipe authority, where genealogy is assembled, what belongs in the historian versus the transactional record, and what an operator does at which screen.
- Lead the remaining platform evaluations batch execution, historian architecture, SCADA, and the MES integration pattern
- Own the MES thread across the running pilot and the larger facility implementation production order flow, electronic batch records, material genealogy, and the ERP interface contract.
- Own the plant information model and the reporting layer built on it OEE, downtime, yield, and quality visibility that process engineering, quality, and operations can act on without an engineer.
- Lead, develop, and grow the SCADA, MES, and data engineering team technical direction, design review, configuration and code standards, and hiring as the plant scales. Serve as the senior escalation point for complex plant-data, SCADA, and MES issues.
- Direct system integrator surge staff and platform vendor delivery teams executing under your standards, and hold contractual knowledge-transfer criteria so the delivered system is ours to operate and modify after they leave.
# Deliverables You Will Develop, Review, or Support
- Normalization layer architecture, unified namespace specification, plant information model, tag and equipment naming standards, and platform evaluation decision records.
- Control room and plant floor HMI screens, tag databases, alarm configuration, historian collection standards, MES/SCADA transaction lists, network and IP lists, password inventories, and system backups.
- ISA-95 object models, electronic batch record and genealogy structures, ERP interface specifications, database schemas, and the plant interface catalog.
- OEM data contract requirements, integration test protocols, FAT and SAT data acceptance criteria, and vendor knowledge-transfer and handover criteria.
- OEE and downtime dashboards, quality and genealogy reports, data quality monitoring, and system administration, backup, and disaster recovery procedures.
Responsibilities and tasks outlined are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of the business
# Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field with 8+ years of experience across industrial automation, manufacturing systems, and plant data platforms.
- Architecture-level ownership not configuration alone - of SCADA, MES/MOM, historian, or plant data platforms, including at least one system you designed that is still running in production.
- Hands-on depth in two or more supervisory or manufacturing systems ecosystems Ignition, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Siemens WinCC Unified/Opcenter, AVEVA, or comparable - with the judgment to assess licensing models, redundancy architectures, and openness of data access on evidence rather than familiarity.
- Production experience with OPC UA and MQTT/Sparkplug B at architecture level broker topology and redundancy, store-and-forward, payload and schema design and versioning - plus proficiency with Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and similar industrial communication standards.
- Working fluency in ISA-95 (production orders, material genealogy, equipment models, batch records) and ISA-88 sufficient to place a batch engine and defend the placement; strong SQL, relational data modeling, and time-series data handling.
- Demonstrated leadership of engineers setting technical direction, developing people, and accountability for delivery you did not personally execute.
Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities
# Desired Skills
- Hands-on delivery with Sepasoft, FactoryTalk Batch, WinCC Unified SIQUENCE, or equivalent, and a considered view on where the batch engine belongs.
- Greenfield Scale-Up: Systems designed before the building was finished, with construction and equipment schedules setting the dates.
- Hybrid Batch and Discrete Processes: A process that moves batch to discrete and back more than once per product; materials, metals, or powder processing especially.
- Heterogeneous OEM Integration: Integrating independently sourced equipment, including machines shipped without a data path that required a gateway, network card, or vendor interface retrofit.
- Historian Architecture at Scale: Collection strategy, retention and archiving, and query performance that holds up when the plant is full.
- Experience carrying a plant through a platform migration or vendor change you know what actually survives one.
- Familiarity with Python, SQL, or other high-level languages for automation and data analytics.
- Experience in heavy industrial, greenfield, or metallurgical manufacturing environments, or in regulated industries such as Defense, Aerospace, or Automotive.
# Physical and Environmental Requirements
The position requires regular presence on the production floor and the ability to navigate all areas of the facility.
Candidates must be able to climb stairs, stand and walk for extended periods, and work in environments that may be hot, humid, or noisy.
The role also requires the use of personal protective equipment, including respirators, and adherence to all applicable safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Employees must be able to complete required fit testing, wear appropriate PPE for the duration of assigned tasks, and respond safely to changing conditions within the production environment.

# CMM PROGRAMMER (2ND SHIFT)
Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production.
Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally-verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost.
Our mission is to make the transformative power of 3D printing available to all industries at scale and unlock the future of innovation.
We are looking for a detail-oriented CMM Inspector/Programmer to join our quality team and take ownership of inspecting complex metal 3D printed parts.
In this hands-on role, you’ll operate our Zeiss Contura CMM using existing Calypso programs, perform part inspections, and clearly communicate results to the engineering and production teams.
You’ll also assist in maintaining inspection tools, documenting results, and continuously improving quality workflows.
Over time, you’ll have opportunities to learn more advanced metrology tools and inspection methods in our growing lab.
If you are detail-oriented and passionate about precision inspection, quality assurance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you!
3D printing experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative individuals who love solving hard problems and creating amazing technology!
# Responsibilities
- Operate Zeiss Contura CMM machine using Calypso for the inspection of complex metal 3D printed parts and geometries.
- Create and execute inspection programs, and ensure parts are measured accurately and consistently.
- Interpret GD&T requirements as applied to engineering drawings and notes, identifying and addressing dimension interpretation issues.
- Choose and utilize appropriate gauges and tools to inspect feature tolerances, ensuring accuracy and adherence to quality standards.
- Collaborate with engineers and quality leads to communicate inspection results and flag potential part or process issues.
- Assist in maintaining and organizing inspection programs, toolkits, and inspection records.
- Support upkeep of CMM equipment and contribute to continuous improvement in inspection workflows.
# Basic Qualifications
- 5+ years of CMM operating experience
- 1+ years of CMM programming experience
- Experience interpreting engineering drawings and understanding GD&T principles
# Nice to Have
- Experience with Zeiss Contura and Calypso
- Experience with CMM inspection of metal 3D printed parts
- Ability to utilize power tools, hand tools, cranes, forklifts, and other heavy equipment
- Ability to lift and/or move up to 30lbs unassisted
- Must be available and willing to work overtime when needed
# Location
- We are located in Hawthorne, CA in a 35,000 square foot, state-of-the-art facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.
# What We Offer
- We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions.
- We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling a world-changing technology.
- Benefits
- Significant stock option packages
- 100% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (premium PPO and HMO options)
- Life insurance
- Traditional and Roth 401(k)
- Relocation assistance provided
- Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays
- Generous Paid Parental Leave and extended transition back to work for the birthing parent
- Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette
